name: locked-door
prompt: Make a door 0.9 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.05 m thick, hinged at its left edge, that opens 90 degrees over a second when clicked, but only after the person has picked up a small key. The key is a 0.1 m by 0.05 m by 0.02 m block placed near the door; clicking it makes it disappear and unlocks the door. Until then clicking the door does nothing.

name: carry-the-key
prompt: Make a small gold key, a 0.12 m by 0.05 m by 0.02 m block, that a person can pick up and carry around. Make a door 0.9 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.05 m thick, hinged at its left edge, which swings open 90 degrees over a second when clicked, but only once the key has been picked up at least once.

name: switch-and-lamp
prompt: Make a lamp: a glowing bulb of radius 0.1 m that emits light, which starts off and fades up to full brightness over 0.3 seconds when a wall switch is clicked, and fades off when the switch is clicked again. The switch is a 0.1 m square plate. The lamp must always match the switch's state.

name: two-levers-vault
prompt: Make a vault door, a slab 1.2 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.1 m thick, that slides up 2 metres over two seconds when it is opened. It opens only while BOTH of two separate levers (0.1 m wide, 0.5 m long bars pivoting at one end) have been pulled down 60 degrees by clicking them. Each lever stays down once pulled.
